entries.title: I Chronicles 16:2
segments: Love to God and generosity to men go well together, and mutually aid each other.

entries.title: I Chronicles 16:7
segments:
This psalm; composed by David, and now first given to the musicians to be sung in public worship. 
 
Singing the praises of God and calling upon his name have ever formed an important part of his worship, and are well suited to the devotions of his people.

entries.title: I Chronicles 16:12
segments: The judgments of his mouth; those decisions and statutes which he had made known for the benefit of the people.

entries.title: I Chronicles 16:14
segments: In all the earth; the Lord reigns among all people, and so manifests himself by his providential dealings with men as to leave them without excuse if they do not love and obey him.

entries.title: I Chronicles 16:15
segments:
A thousand generations; a definite for a long indefinite period. 
 
The covenant which God hath made in Christ with his people, is an everlasting covenant, and its blessings are sure to all who put their trust in him.

entries.title: I Chronicles 16:23
segments: Praising God for his salvation, and praying that all may be made partakers of it, should form an important part of our daily duties.

entries.title: I Chronicles 16:30
segments: The world also shall be stable; in the original, the same as
, "The world also is established, that it cannot be moved;" where see note

entries.title: I Chronicles 16:33
segments: To judge the earth; deal righteously with men according to their character.

entries.title: I Chronicles 16:34
segments: The mercy of God in Christ is the only ground of hope for lost and guilty men.  On this they should depend, while they glory in him as their righteousness, wisdom, and strength.

entries.title: I Chronicles 16:37
segments: The ark; this was carried to Jerusalem; and a part of the priests resided there with David to minister before it.  Another part resided at Gibeon, where the tabernacle and brazen altar still remained, and where was offered the daily sacrifice.

entries.title: I Chronicles 16:41
segments: With them; with Zadok and his brethren at Gibeon.  See note to

entries.title: I Chronicles 16:43
segments:
Bless his house; instruct and implore blessings upon his household, and engage with them in the worship of God. 
 
While the public worship of God should not be neglected, but statedly observed according to divine appointment, it should never supersede, or be suffered to hinder the regular observance of family duties.
